newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dealers set mortgage-backed securities plan.
newsitem.headline: Canada dealers set mortgage-backed securities plan.

text.p: Seven investment dealers said on Thursday they had formed a syndicate to revitalize the Canadian market for government-guaranteed National Housing Act Mortgage-Backed Securities.

The seven dealers are Goldman Sachs Canada, Nesbitt Burns, Scotia Capital Markets, CIBC-Wood Gundy Inc, Levesque Beaubien Geoffrion, RBC Dominion Securities Inc and Toronto-Dominion Securities, with Canada Trust committing to assist in developing liquidity and investor participation in the market.
The dealers said in a released statement that the securities offer AAA rated government guaranteed investment option for Canadian investors looking for alternatives to Canadian government bonds.
"We believe this is just the beginning of an overdue Canadian securitization market, the magnitude of which should extend into the billions of dollars," said Nesbitt Burns Vice Chairman Jim Beqaj.
The securities represent an undivided interest in a Government of Canada guaranteed pool of residential mortgages for sale as fixed-yield debt securities for a minimum of C$5,000.
